name: Dubuffet cells
description: Abstract cell drawings: the surface broken into irregular, asymmetric cells with thick hand-drawn black contours, straight runs meeting rounded corners, odd notches, bulges and branches. Usually many cells, from dozens to hundreds, with smaller cells nested inside larger ones. Cells are filled with thin parallel hand-drawn stripes, plain white, or flat solid colour; white is a main fill and red and blue lead. Purely abstract, no faces, figures or objects.
light: brushy white paint with bold red and blue stripes and small solid red and blue patches, on white
flat cream cells and flat solid red and light-blue cells on a black ground, clean screen-print finish
muted grey, burgundy and slate-blue cells on a warm grey ground, brushy paint
mostly white cells with a few black cells striped in thin white lines, red and blue accents
composition: dense all-over field to every edge, cells nested 3-4 levels deep, many tiny cells
one upright isolated cluster on a black ground, built from a few large cells
big tangled white corridors looping and crossing over large striped fields
knots of tiny squiggly cells sitting next to large striped slabs, strong contrast of scale
sparse: a handful of large cells filling the frame, some holding a smaller cell inside
camera_or_medium: marker, felt pen and vinyl paint on paper or panel; flat, confident black contour
texture_detail: a thin red dashed line runs inside every black outline; fine, dense stripes, a different angle in each cell; slight hand wobble
clean black outlines with no dashes; wide-spaced thin stripes in only a few cells, the rest flat white or solid colour
stripes in every direction, horizontal, vertical, steep and shallow diagonals mixed, some cells white stripes on black
brushy paint, stripes slightly thick and uneven, outlines of very uneven weight, visible brush marks in the white
avoid: jigsaw puzzle pieces, tabs and sockets
grid alignment, rows and columns of cells
dashed centre lines like road markings
uniform-width corridors everywhere, worm or snake shapes
pop-art accents in pink, teal or yellow
subjects: an endless hand-drawn floor plan of nested striped and white cells
a single floating cluster of lumpy cells
bands of red and blue hatched cells like a striped map
looping black contours half closing into cells on a dark ground
prefer: unequal cell sizes, nested compartments, white interiors and fine red or blue stripes at varied angles
